content_sections.body: In this lesson, focus on a claim, a because-clause, and a specific supporting example. Notice how the ideas about local news apps are linked so that the listener can follow the speaker's meaning.
content_sections.title: Notice the language

content_sections.body: I prefer local news apps because they report transport changes quickly. For instance, an alert helped me choose another bus route during roadworks yesterday.
content_sections.title: Context and meaning

content_sections.body: Prepare a three-sentence response about local news apps. Include the lesson language, one concrete detail, and a clear link between your ideas.
